cases.question: 2024年每个大区的销售额分别是多少？（口径见业务指标 sales_amount）
cases.sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS sales_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE o.order_status IN (%s, %s, %s) AND o.created_at >= %s AND o.created_at < %s GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS sales_amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('completed','shipped','refunded') AND o.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name
